_provenance.status: RECORDED SEED — app-authored page documents for the content catalogue (Phase 0+1 of data/villa-content-catalog-plan/report.md, captain review 2026-09-21). NOT a service response: no content contract exists, so this fixture store is the write path in fixture mode (see lib/api-client/content-pages.ts).
sources: The hero words are the CURRENT PAGE COPY, transcribed from the live pages so the editable document starts as what visitors read today — never new marketing copy:
The Home document is NOT stored here: it is the landing content document (lib/fixtures/landing/content.json) and is listed in Pages & content with its own full editor.
Tabs for the park: Park view (/map) + Lots (/map?tab=lots) — the captain's 2026-09-21 direction that the Lot page is a tab inside the park page.

The plans document's blocks (Phase 2, captain's 2026-09-21 direction: five tiers + per-tier inclusion checklists, no services) record the CURRENT plan copy the page published from lib/villa-pricing.ts: the five tiers' inclusion checklists, the complete memorial package table, eligibility, senior terms and the five plan notes. Stable block ids set the typed reading in lib/plan-content.ts; every string is the client's own (COMPLETE MEMORIAL PACKAGE / TYPES OF COFFIN sheets).

The plans tier cards (captain's 2026-09-21 premium-tier direction) each carry an optional one-line `summary` and an optional `image`. The seeded summaries transcribe the TYPES OF COFFIN sheet's own tier descriptions + lid lines (lib/villa-pricing.ts COFFINS) — no new marketing claim. `image` is null in the seed: the card is premium text-only until staff attach a photograph.

The services document's blocks (Phase 3) carry the service descriptions the page published in code: the five a-la-carte notes (services-alacarte-*) and the two chapel-class copy lines (services-chapel-*). Stable block ids set the typed reading in lib/service-content.ts; a missing block falls back to the same copy. The three guide service entries live in lib/fixtures/content/service-entries.json.

No price, amount or figure is authored anywhere in this file; price blocks bind to catalogue SKUs / the pricing store. The cash-assistance table stays a sheet constant (lib/villa-pricing.ts CASH_ASSISTANCE), never a free-text block.

hero.headline: Villa Memorial Plan
hero.lead: The park's memorial plan — five tiers, four ways to pay.

blocks.heading: Bronze 1
blocks.summary: Wooden or metal coffin with a smooth finish, elegant handles and a half-glass lid.

blocks.heading: Bronze 2
blocks.summary: Wooden or metal coffin with a smooth finish, elegant handles and a full-glass lid.

blocks.heading: Silver 1
blocks.summary: A slightly bigger, more elegant coffin, with a half-glass lid.

blocks.heading: Silver 2
blocks.summary: A slightly bigger, more elegant coffin, with a cover convertible to full-glass or half-glass.

blocks.heading: Gold
blocks.summary: A special metal coffin, more stylish and sophisticated, with a cover convertible to full-glass or half-glass.

blocks.heading: Complete memorial package includes
rows: Retrieval of the deceased to the morgue and delivery of the same in casket. Good for the first 25 kms only.
Embalming with make-up and dressing. The type of coffin differs with the plan.
State-of-the-Art and classy equipment which includes lights, curtains and carpets.
Several cars will be ready and bring the deceased to its final destination.
Free! flowers and tarpaulin are included with the complete memorial package.

blocks.heading: Senior citizen eligibility & terms
items: Senior citizens have no insurance benefit

blocks.heading: Limited contestability
blocks.text: Inception date is 30 days after payment. Contestability period is 7 months after payment.

blocks.heading: Assignable and transferable
blocks.text: The plan is assignable and transferable to anyone. Transfer/assignment fee is ₱1,000.
All packages include FREE flowers and a tarpaulin.
Amortization can be adjusted to 8 years and 10 years.

blocks.heading: Who serves and underwrites the plan
blocks.text: Served by Funeraria Villa & ZC-Arcega Funeral Homes, underwritten by Villa Agency Insurance Services. Affiliated parlors: Funeraria Villa – Capilla de San Jose, Isabela City, Basilan · Funeraria Villa – National Highway, Brgy. Salvacion, Panabo City · Villa ZC-Arcega Funeral Homes – Zamboanga City · all Villa-affiliated funeral parlors around Mindanao.
